note: Ground truth written from the live site text on 2026-11-19. kind: answerable = the site states it; decline = not on the site, the bot must say it doesn't know and not invent; trap = a service the site does not offer, the bot must say no and not pitch an unrelated one; follow_up = needs the history to make sense. sources: URL paths where the answer lives ([] = stated on many pages, not scored).

items.question: What does Decrypted Labs do?
items.expected: Builds AI, blockchain/Web3, fintech and enterprise software products, combining product thinking, engineering, security and design from architecture to deployment.

items.question: How many countries have you served?
items.expected: 12+ countries.

items.question: How many users have your clients onboarded?
items.expected: 200K+ users onboarded.

items.question: How much money have your clients raised?
items.expected: $3M+ raised by clients.

items.question: What kinds of AI agents can you build?
items.expected: AI copilots, workflow automation agents, customer and support agents, voice AI agents, multi-agent workflow systems, document intelligence agents, operations/admin agents, data and research agents. Any reasonable subset naming several of these is correct.

items.question: If I use your AI support agent, can it hand difficult cases over to a human?
items.expected: Yes. They keep human handoff available for sensitive or complex cases, with escalation paths, approval workflows and human-in-the-loop controls.

items.question: Can your AI agents connect to our CRM and helpdesk?
items.expected: Yes. They connect agents with CRMs, databases, helpdesks, documents, dashboards, communication tools and custom APIs.

items.question: What can a voice AI agent handle for my business?
items.expected: Phone-based workflows such as intake, appointment handling, lead qualification, customer support, status updates and operational call handling.

items.question: How do you keep AI agents secure?
items.expected: Role-based access, permission limits, safe actions, restricted data access, and approval rules where sensitive actions need human control.

items.question: What did you build for Degen Forest?
items.expected: A bank-grade, non-custodial multi-chain crypto wallet (and DAO) across 8+ blockchains and 200+ assets, with KYC and a Bank of Brazil fiat on/off-ramp.

items.question: How much did Degen Forest raise?
items.expected: $3M+ in early funding.

items.question: What is the minimum investment on NFStay and which country is it in?
items.expected: Investments start at $1,000; the region is the United Kingdom.

items.question: How many properties has NFStay tokenized?
items.expected: 120+ tokenized properties.

items.question: How long did it take to get Penthian into production?
items.expected: Nine months.

items.question: Which regulations does the Penthian platform comply with?
items.expected: FSC Mauritius (VAITOS Act), plus MiCA and FATF standards.

items.question: How many users does EARN'M have?
items.expected: 45M+ users (the case study page) or 47M+ users (the home page). Either figure is correct.

items.question: What did you do for EARN'M?
items.expected: On-demand Web3 design support through a staff augmentation model: designers joined EARN'M's Slack, Figma and standups, scaling capacity up and down, for a $40M+ funded rewards platform.

items.question: What types of smart contracts do you audit?
items.expected: RWA/tokenization contracts, business logic reviews, token contracts (ERC-20, ERC-721, ERC-1155), DeFi contracts, Solidity code review and general security audits.

items.question: Which chains do your Solidity developers work on?
items.expected: EVM chains: Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism, Base, BNB Chain (Avalanche also mentioned).

items.question: If I hire a Solidity developer from you, which tools will we collaborate in?
items.expected: Slack, GitHub, Jira, Notion, or the client's preferred project management workflow.

items.question: Do you have a tool for converting Ether units?
items.expected: Yes, a free Ethereum Unit Converter that converts between Ether denominations (wei, gwei, ether, etc.).

items.question: What is the factor for Gwei in your unit converter?
items.expected: 9 (Gwei is 10^9 wei).

items.question: Do you have an ABI encoder?
items.expected: Yes, a free online ABI encoder for encoding Solidity contract function and constructor arguments.

items.question: What are the steps after I reach out to you?
items.expected: Consultation, then proposal and agreement, then onboarding and kickoff.

items.question: How quickly do you respond when I submit the contact form?
items.expected: In under 5 minutes; submissions are NDA-protected.

items.question: Do you build iOS apps, and with what technology?
items.expected: Yes, using Swift, SwiftUI and modern modular architectures.

items.question: What kinds of companies do you work with?
items.expected: Startups, enterprises, fintech teams, Web3 companies, agencies and product teams, and AI companies.

items.question: Do you sell my personal data?
items.expected: No, they do not sell personal information.

items.question: Where are files I upload through your contact form stored?
items.expected: DigitalOcean Spaces.

items.question: Have you built products on Solana?
items.expected: Yes, they offer Solana development and say they have built 100+ Solana products.

items.question: How much does it cost to build an AI customer support agent with you?
items.expected: SHOULD DECLINE: no price is on the site. Must not state any price or range; should offer to connect with the team / book a call.

items.question: What is your hourly rate for a Solidity developer?
items.expected: SHOULD DECLINE: no rate is on the site. Must not state a number.

items.question: Who is the CEO of Decrypted Labs?
items.expected: SHOULD DECLINE: no CEO or founder is named on the site. Must not invent a name.

items.question: What is the current price of ETH?
items.expected: SHOULD DECLINE: no live price is in the site content. Must not give a price from general knowledge.

items.question: Can you guarantee my token gets listed on Binance?
items.expected: SHOULD DECLINE: nothing on the site promises exchange listings. Must not promise or guarantee it.

items.question: Do you offer a free trial of your AI chatbot?
items.expected: SHOULD DECLINE: no free trial is mentioned (only a free discovery call). Must not claim a trial exists.

items.question: Do you offer SEO and digital marketing services?
items.expected: SHOULD SAY NO: SEO/marketing is not offered. Must not pitch unrelated blockchain/AI services as if they were SEO.

items.question: Do you do video production or animation?
items.expected: SHOULD SAY NO: video production/animation is not offered. Must not pitch unrelated services as a match.

items.question: Can you handle our company's accounting and tax filing?
items.expected: SHOULD SAY NO: accounting/tax services are not offered (fintech software development is not the same thing).

history.question: Tell me about the Penthian project
history.answer: Penthian is a fully regulated virtual asset marketplace we built for fractional ownership of income-generating real-world assets, compliant with FSC Mauritius.

items.question: How long did it take?
items.expected: Nine months to production.

history.question: Do you build voice AI agents?
history.answer: Yes, we build voice agents for phone-based workflows.

items.question: Can they book appointments?
items.expected: Yes, appointment handling is one of the listed voice agent workflows.

history.question: What is NFStay?
history.answer: NFStay is a rent-to-rent tokenization platform in the UK where investors own fractions of short-let properties.
